surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
SOURCE: Untrusted caller inputs `executable` and `arguments`.
TRUST: Adversary controls the executable name and argument strings.
SINK: Direct exec subprocess with argument vector; shell processing disabled.
GUARD: Allowlist executable strictly to `/usr/bin/printf` or `/bin/echo`; reject every other executable with ValueError.
ORDER: Validate executable against allowlist before spawning; pass supplied arguments as direct vector without shell interpretation.
EFFECT: Return captured stdout decoded as text; ValueError on disallowed executable; propagate process failures.
END_PLAN
